# National Geographic Kids

> > Educational website offering kids engaging content about geography, animals, science, and nature through games, quizzes, and videos.

National Geographic Kids provides age-appropriate educational content featuring country profiles, regional geography of the United States, wildlife information, and interactive learning experiences. The site includes popular series like Weird But True! and Nature Boom Time, helping children explore the world through fun, fact-based content.

## Key Topics

- Geography and Countries
- United States Regions
- Animals and Wildlife
- Science and Nature
- Educational Games and Quizzes
- Weird But True!
- Nature Boom Time
- North America
- Pacific Ocean and Atlantic Ocean
- American Landmarks (Golden Gate Bridge, Washington D.C.)
- Country Profiles
- Kids Education
- Interactive Videos
- Environmental Learning

## Home

- [National Geographic Kids | National Geographic Kids](https://kids.nationalgeographic.com/): Homepage for National Geographic Kids with games, quizzes, and nature content

## Geography and Countries

- [United States | National Geographic Kids](https://kids.nationalgeographic.com/geography/countries/article/united-states): Country profile of United States covering geography and regional facts
